property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(x) sets owner to the supplied address x; the mutant instead sets owner to msg.sender, so for some fuzzed _owner values (where _owner != caller) the mutant's owner differs from the supplied _owner and thus violates the rule.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to owner with assigning msg.sender instead of _owner so owner becomes caller after setOwner.
